book_level_anchors.decision: Preserve trial/testing/temptation word-family across James 1 without flattening contextual differences.
Preserve hearer/doer/action language and connect it with faith/works in chapter 2.
Keep faith and deeds explicit throughout chapter 2; use works as a vocabulary bridge. Do not harmonize James into Romans.
Use project term set right for dikaioō while apparatus preserves justify/vindicate/show-right range.
Preserve wisdom-from-above versus earthly wisdom contrast.
Preserve tongue/speech/teaching/bridling networks across chapters 1, 3, and 4.
Preserve rich/poor/status reversal and anti-partiality themes.
Preserve hypomonē/makrothymia endurance/patience motifs from trials to the Lord's coming.
Preserve prayer/confession/healing/restoration cluster in James 5 without mechanistic expansion.

f3_decisions.decision: Choose wavering for diakrinomenos while noting doubting/divided alternatives and the link to 1:8; keep the image intact.
Retain crown and trial/testing language; God makes the implied referent explicit without claiming the pinned Greek contains an explicit Lord at this point.
Follow the pinned SBLGNT location/order of stand or sit there; retain the degrading footstool image and note the variant behind the former wording.
Keep the inherited quotation boundary while flagging disputed speaker boundaries; use a verb for the final erga without losing the repeated faith/deeds contrast.
Retain the consequential set right choice with explicit alternatives in the note; keep father, son, altar, and the by-deeds claim intact.
Retain the explicit conclusion and existing dikaioo choice; do not replace it with only shown to already be righteous.
Unfold the parallel example without hiding Rahab's description or adding a motive; retain the same set right/deeds wording.
Break the dense syntax into sentences without losing any of the images; retain Gehenna and document the difficult course-of-life expression.
Make eupeithes intelligible as open to persuasion; retain good fruit and the disputed impartial choice with its alternatives noted.
Use active English while retaining the unusual sowing-a-harvest image; note the alternative dative reading for peacemakers instead of by peacemakers.
Follow the sequence of the pinned Greek without adding so between wanting and murder; note the punctuation question and retain murder without softening it.
Retain the existing God-subject reading in clearer English; keep the major spirit-subject alternative and uncertain citation identification in the note.
Retain the existing fire attachment while noting the pinned edition's alternative punctuation; preserve flesh, corrosion, hoarding, and last days.
Retain hearts and slaughter rather than replacing them with an explanation; use on for en instead of silently importing a future-oriented for.
Preserve the singular figure and inherited declarative reading; note that the pinned edition punctuates the final clause as a question.
Render telos as outcome while noting purpose/end alternatives; keep endurance, Job, blessing, and the compassionate Lord.
Keep save and raise distinct and retain the conditional presence of sins; avoid turning illness into proof of sin or promising a medical mechanism.
Preserve mutual confession/prayer and the healing purpose; leave the participle's agency open and record the energized/effective alternatives.
Preserve turning, way, life/death, and covering; retain the open life referent and note the Greek possessive rather than silently erasing its ambiguity.
